fields.label: Maintain Stock
fields.description: ERPNext will make a stock ledger entry for each transaction of this item. Keep unchecked for non-stock or service items.

fields.label: Is Fixed Asset
fields.description: Enable if this item is a company asset like machinery or furniture.

fields.label: Create Grouped Asset
fields.description: Creates a single grouped asset instead of individual assets when purchased in bulk.

fields.label: Allow Sales
fields.description: Allow this item to be used in sales transactions.

fields.label: Allow Alternative Item
fields.description: Allow substituting this item with an alternative from the Item Alternative list when stock is unavailable.

fields.label: Has Variants
fields.description: If this item has variants, then it cannot be selected in sales orders etc.

fields.label: Allow Purchase
fields.description: Allow this item to be used in purchase transactions.

fields.label: Is Customer Provided Item
fields.description: Enable if this item is provided by a customer and received via Stock Entry.

fields.label: Standard Selling Rate
fields.description: Creates an Item Price automatically when the item is saved

fields.label: Opening Stock
fields.description: Used to create an opening Stock Entry with the Valuation Rate when the item is saved

fields.label: Over Delivery/Receipt Allowance (%)
fields.description: Percentage by which over-delivery or over-receipt is allowed against a Sales/Purchase Order for this item. If not set, value from Stock Settings will be used.

fields.label: Over Billing Allowance (%)
fields.description: Percentage by which over-billing is allowed against a Sales/Purchase Order for this item. If not set, value from Accounts Settings will be used.

fields.label: Enable Deferred Expense
fields.description: Expense for this item will be recognized over a period of months. Eg: prepaid insurance or annual software license

fields.label: Enable Deferred Revenue
fields.description: Income from this item will be recognized over a period of months instead of all at once. Eg: annual subscription paid upfront.

fields.options: Define alternate units for this item. Eg: 1 Box = 12 Nos, set conversion factor as 12. (Will also apply for variants) Learn more →

fields.label: Taxes
fields.description: Will also apply for variants

fields.description: Defines the date after which the item can no longer be used in transactions or manufacturing

fields.options:
Purchase
Material Transfer
Material Issue
Manufacture

fields.label: Allow Negative Stock
fields.description: Allow stock to go below zero for this item, even if negative stock is disabled in Stock Settings.

fields.label: Reorder level based on Warehouse
fields.description: Will also apply for variants unless overridden

fields.label: Has Batch No
fields.description: Track this item in batches. Cannot be changed after a stock transaction exists.

fields.label: Automatically Create New Batch
fields.description: Batch number will be auto-created in format AAAA.00001 if not specified in transactions. Leave blank to always enter batch numbers manually.

fields.label: Batch Number Series
fields.description: Example: ABCD.#####. If series is set and Batch No is not mentioned in transactions, then automatic batch number will be created based on this series. If you always want to explicitly mention Batch No for this item, leave this blank. Note: this setting will take priority over the Naming Series Prefix in Stock Settings.

fields.label: Has Expiry Date
fields.description: Batch number will be created based on expiry date. Expiry dates can be set in the Batch master.

fields.label: Retain Sample
fields.description: Enable to reserve a small sample from each batch for any analysis arising ahead

fields.label: Max Sample Quantity
fields.description: Maximum sample quantity that can be retained

fields.label: Has Serial No
fields.description: Track each unit with a unique serial number for warranty and return tracking. Cannot be changed after a stock transaction exists.

fields.label: Serial Number Series
fields.description:
Example: ABCD.#####
If series is set and Serial No is not mentioned in transactions, then automatic serial number will be created based on this series. If you always want to explicitly mention Serial Nos for this item. leave this blank.

fields.label: Variant Of
fields.description: If item is a variant of another item then description, image, pricing, taxes etc will be set from the template unless explicitly specified

fields.label: Minimum Order Qty
fields.description: Minimum quantity should be as per Stock UOM

fields.label: Safety Stock
fields.description: Minimum stock level to maintain as a buffer. Used to calculate recommended reorder level: Reorder Level = Safety Stock + (Average Daily Consumption × Lead Time).

fields.label: Lead Time in days
fields.description: Average time taken by the supplier to deliver

fields.label: Last Purchase Rate
fields.description: The rate at which this item was last purchased via a Purchase Invoice. Auto-updated by the system.

fields.label: Delivered by Supplier (Drop Ship)
fields.description: Enable for drop shipping - supplier delivers directly to the customer without passing through your warehouse.

fields.label: Grant Commission
fields.description: If enabled, sales from this item will be included in Sales Person and Sales Partner commission calculations

fields.label: Max Discount (%)
fields.description: Maximum discount % allowed when selling this item. Eg: if set to 20%, a discount greater than 20% cannot be applied in sales transactions.

fields.label: Include Item In Manufacturing
fields.description: Enable for raw material items used in BOM. Uncheck for additional services like 'washing' used in manufacturing.

fields.label: Is Subcontracted Item
fields.description: Enable if a vendor manufactures this item for you. You can choose to provide them raw materials using the default BOM.

fields.label: Inspection Required before Purchase
fields.description: A quality inspection must be completed before generating a Purchase Receipt for this item.

fields.label: Inspection Required before Delivery
fields.description: A quality inspection must be completed before generating a Delivery Note for this item.
